command: set -u; SVC=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service; PID=$(systemctl --user show "$SVC" -p MainPID --value); echo "PID=$PID"; systemctl --user show "$SVC" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --no-pager; echo '===PROCESS==='; ps -o pid,ppid,stat,lstart,etime,cmd -p "$PID"; echo '===CHILDREN==='; pgrep -a -P "$PID" || true; echo '===SOCKETS==='; ss -tpn 2>/dev/null | grep "pid=$PID," || true; echo '===VOICE_JOURNAL_10MIN==='; journalctl --user -u "$SVC" --since '-10 min' --no-pager -n 120 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===STATE_FILES==='; for f in /home/ai-core-node/.local/state/frankenstein-voice-final/* /home/ai-core-node/.cache/frankenstein-voice-final/*; do [ -e "$f" ] && stat -c '%y %s %n' "$f"; done 2>/dev/null | tail -40 || true
